title: Enterprise and government AI infrastructure spending

sources.label: IDC: AI Is Short of Capacity, Not Demand
sources.quote: non-service-provider spending on AI infrastructure steadily rising from $28.6 billion in 2025 to $96.4 billion in 2030

note: IDC October 22, 2026 HPC/AI Index: non-service-provider buyers (enterprises and governments). Publisher’s 2025 baseline and 2030 forecast, USD billions, not an observed actual series. Excludes service-provider procurement and non-AI IT infrastructure; not comparable to Gartner worldwide total AI spending or IDC US AI spending.
